rows.note: Use this for the head of government in a German-speaking country, rather than for an ordinary government minister.

example.english: The German chancellor is visiting Hong Kong today.

rows.note: Use this as the formal title for a senior government minister or official with a particular administrative portfolio.

example.english: The chancellor read out the new budget in the Legislative Council today.
example.traditional: 財政大臣今日喺立法會宣讀新預算案。
example.jyutping: coi4 zing3 daai6 san4 gam1 jat6 hai2 lap6 faat3 wui6 syun1 duk6 san1 jyu6 syun3 on3
